title: refactor(plugin-grid): move ObjectGrid's grouping and column summaries into sibling hooks (slice 6)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi94Cr2fbhp665MVvsYFfqYFe)_

Part of #25994 (slice 6 of the move-only split; slices 1–5 landed as #26323, #26354, #26364, #26499 and #26537, and the card stays open for the slices listed below).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What moved

Base `f48aa451` (`main` with slice 5). `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` is 5639 lines there. This slice moves concerns **N**, **O** and **P** of the seam table in #26364, as re-planned in #26499. They are adjacent and above the first early return. Each block becomes a custom hook called where its lines stood:

| # | Concern | Lines on `f48aa451` | New home |
|---|---|---|---|
| N | The group value formatter and the date-family group faces (`temporalGroupFaces`) | 1343–1451 | `useObjectGridGrouping` in `objectGridGrouping.ts` |
| O | The render grouping, then server grouping: header and row-page queries, option ranks, the grouped data (`groups`, `isGrouped`, `toggleGroup`), the server leaves' rows and the match total | 1453–1612 | the same hook (N feeds O directly) |
| — | `TemporalGroupFace` and `temporalGroupHeading` (module level, with their docblocks) | 592–644 | `objectGridGrouping.ts` |
| P | The query the cross-page fan-out replays (`bulkFanoutParams`), the resolved match total, and the column summaries (`summaries`, `hasSummary`) | 1614–1694 | `useObjectGridSummaries` in `objectGridSummaries.ts` |

`TemporalGroupFace` is the type N builds its faces with, so it moves with N, and `temporalGroupHeading`'s docblock is about that type, so the two stay together. `temporalGroupHeading` gains the `export` keyword, and `ObjectGrid.tsx` imports it back for the one call in the grouped table's band (line 4879 there). #26341, which last edited these two, has landed.

Hook inputs are passed explicitly and typed from their source; no context is added and no `any` is introduced:

- Values from slices 4 and 5 are typed as `ReturnType<typeof useObjectGridQueryInputs>[name]`, `ReturnType<typeof useObjectGridGroupingDecisions>[name]`, `ReturnType<typeof useObjectGridRowLoad>['invalidationNonce']`, and P's `isGrouped` as `ReturnType<typeof useObjectGridGrouping>['isGrouped']`.
- `t` and `translateOptions` are `ReturnType<typeof useGridTranslation>['t']` and `ReturnType<typeof useSafeFieldLabel>['translateOptions']`.
- `objectFields` is `Record<string, any>` in the component. The hook types it as what it reads: `GridCellFieldLike` (the cell face's own input type) plus `type?: string` and `options?: Parameters<translateOptions>[2]`.
- `data` is `unknown[]` in the grouping hook and `Parameters<typeof useScopedColumnSummary>[1]` in the summaries hook. `objectSchema` is `{ fields?: Parameters<typeof useScopedColumnSummary>[2] } | null`. Setters are `React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<…>>` of their state's type (`unknown[]` for `data`).

The grouping hook returns the 7 names the rest of the component reads, and the summaries hook returns 4. The component destructures them under the same names. No identifier is renamed. Nothing new is exported from `ObjectGrid.tsx`, and the package entry is untouched. Seventeen import specifiers move with their only readers (four whole import lines among them). `ObjectGrid.tsx` goes from 5639 to 5250 lines. The diff is 965 changed lines.

Move-only proof: the multiset of non-blank lines of the base `ObjectGrid.tsx` equals the new `ObjectGrid.tsx` plus the two modules. Nothing is missing except the 3 edited import lines, which differ only by the removed specifiers, and `function temporalGroupHeading(`, which now reads `export function temporalGroupHeading(`. The only added lines are the module headers and imports, the `ReturnType` aliases and the `GroupingFieldDef` type, the two hook signatures and `return { … }` lists, and in `ObjectGrid.tsx` the two imports plus the two calls with their two-line comments.

## Open PRs on `ObjectGrid.tsx`

None. I checked all 17 open PRs at the claim (07:55Z): none touches `ObjectGrid.tsx` or its `objectGrid*` siblings.

## Source pins and test edits

None. I matched every string literal of every test that reads `ObjectGrid.tsx` against the moved lines (the hooks and the two module-level declarations), and the only hits were generic phrases in prose. `groupDateHeading-13234.test.tsx`, which holds each date heading to the cell under it, is a behavioural test and needs no edit. `iconOnlyButtonCensus-12143` counts the two icon-only pagers that stay in `ObjectGrid.tsx`.

## Remaining slices

As re-planned in #26499: **7 — C + D + E** (row-height sync, column-state persistence, pull to refresh; re-points `gridNonAuthorKeys`' `columnState` reads), and **8 — R + U + V** (closes the card; re-points the five `generateColumns` pins).

## Verification

Run on `39923d86`. The head is now `67836999`, which only renames the grouping hook's local field type from `ObjectFieldLike` to `GroupingFieldDef`: Type Check UI's `check:spec-symbols` refused the first name because `@objectstack/spec/system` exports it. On `67836999` I re-ran `type-check` (exit 0) and all 16 `check:*` steps of the Type Check UI job (`check:phantom-deps` through `check:i18n-designer-parity`, every one exit 0).

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/ --maxWorkers=2`, the whole package suite, under the verification lock: 253 of 253 files, 2256 of 2256 tests. The before reading is the same count on slice 5 (#26537, CI green on `5345a340`).
- The 52 test files outside plugin-grid that read sources (the list slices 1–5 used): 52 of 52 files, 2258 of 2258 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` exit 0.
- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console`: 70 of 70 tasks.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:doc-example-readers` exit 0 (the newly exported `temporalGroupHeading` is not a shared reader).
- eslint on the three files: 0 errors. Warnings go from 206 to 198, and no dependency array changed. Three `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` messages now name the setters `setData`, `setTotalMatching` and `setGroupedPage`, because a setter that arrives as a hook parameter is not known to be stable. Three `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` warnings and eight `react-hooks/refs` warnings ("Cannot access refs during render", on `lastFindParamsRef.current` feeding `bulkFanoutParams`) are no longer raised, for the same reason: the rules recognise a setter or a ref only where `useState` / `useRef` declares it. Those eleven are not fixed, only out of the rules' sight; the reads are byte-identical.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 29 derived gates, all exit 0 (the `vitest run scripts/` gate ran under the lock: 178 files, 5097 tests); `--ran` reconciles 29 of 29 (0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN).

## Landing

No other open PR touches these files, so this can land as soon as CI is green.

Changeset: `.changeset/25994-objectgrid-grouping-summaries-hooks.md` (patch, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`).
